description: This file defines a Remix route component for handling 404 Not Found pages. It includes a loader function returning a JSON response with the unmatched path and a React component rendering the 404 page UI.

methods.name: loader
methods.description: Loader function that returns a JSON object with the unmatched path and a 404 status code.

methods.name: NotFound
methods.description: React component rendering a 404 not found message.
